examples.title: Child-care subsidy review desk (state-built system)
examples.description: Staff use a state-built score to order child-care subsidy files before a supervisor decides.

examples.title: Road-closure notice drafter (state-built system)
examples.description: A state-built drafter proposes road-closure notices that a traffic supervisor edits before posting.

examples.title: Park mowing schedule helper (state-built system)
examples.description: Crew leads use a state-built forecast of mowing time. It does not decide a service for a person.

examples.title: Visitation window suggester (state-built system)
examples.description: A state-built scheduler, calling an outside model, suggests visitation windows for a custody supervisor to accept or change.

examples.title: Benefits appeal ranker (state-built system)
examples.description: Appeal files are ranked by a state-built tool. The saved answers say planning, while a start date is already filled in, and most safeguards are blank.

examples.title: Benefits eligibility triage (vendor product)
examples.description: Eligibility staff review a vendor score before any benefit file moves forward.

examples.title: Workplace injury summary assistant (vendor product)
examples.description: An agency-extended vendor assistant drafts injury summaries that a safety reviewer checks.

examples.title: Library hold-time forecast (vendor product)
examples.description: Branch leads see a vendor forecast of how long a hold might take. No case decision is made.

examples.title: Rental assistance waitlist sorter (vendor product)
examples.description: A vendor product sorts rental-assistance applicants. Review covers a sample, and several controls are still open.

examples.title: Occupational license score (vendor product)
examples.description: A vendor score can hold up a license file. Review, data level, and procurement timing are not determined.

examples.title: Path example: benefits queue (High)
examples.description: Staff use a state-built score to order benefit files. A supervisor decides each file.

examples.title: Path example: grounds forecast (General)
examples.description: Crew leads see a state-built forecast of mowing time. It does not decide a service for a person.

examples.title: Path example: social scoring tool (Prohibited)
examples.description: A state-built tool scores personal traits. That use is on the prohibited list.

examples.title: Path example: certified hold forecast (General, in-scope certificates)
examples.description: A vendor forecast shows hold time. SOC 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 cover this product. The path stays General.
